name: OKC_REVIEW_MESSAGES
description: This table is used to store the messages during the upoload of Word document.  As part of uploading the word document, message during the review process are stored in this table.

columns.name: REVIEW_MESSAGES_ID
columns.description: Sequence Id - Ptimary Key for OKC_REVIEW_MESSAGES

columns.name: REVIEW_UPLD_TERMS_ID
columns.description: Reference to Clause or Section or root id stored in OKC_REVIEW_UPLOADED_TERMS table

columns.name: ERROR_SEVERITY
columns.description: Code that denotes Severity as Error or Warning

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Message Name for the error or warning.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: Variable Code for which this message is used

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN1
columns.description: Token1 of the message  uploaded to the word doc

columns.name: MESSAGE_VALUE1
columns.description: Value of Token1 of the message  uploaded to the word doc
